issues.sourceText: The cumulative incidence of VA was extremely low in LGE cases, significantly lower than that of LGE+ ones (0.8% vs 21.1%, P < 0.001).
issues.reason: The first group is written LGE without a minus sign. Elsewhere the same abstract explicitly refers to absence of LGE, but this sentence itself does not explicitly mark the first group positive or negative. This is substantive local ambiguity rather than funding/non-abstract contamination or visible truncation.
issues.translationConstraint: Do not silently add a minus sign to the source or translate this clause as explicitly LGE-negative without acknowledging that its local label is unspecified. Preserve the saved source and sourceHash.
issues.quicklookConstraint: Do not rely on this ambiguous sentence for a standalone quantitative negative-versus-positive group finding. Use the separately explicit absence-of-LGE/without-LGE sentences and conclusion for supported findings.
issues.gateDecision: Not blocked for faithful public-abstract translation with the ambiguity explicitly retained; this review does not resolve it through an online lookup.
